# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza has a tall, slender frame with sharp angles rather than curves, and dark hair with graying strands bound at the back in a tight, firm bun. Her features remain sharp as her hair becomes more silvered over time. She routinely wears an oval amethyst brooch framing a woven lock of her mother's hair over her best brown satin gown for church.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Thirza possesses a firm sense of morality and maintains extreme order and painful cleanliness at Grey Shutters. Though often stern, sharp-tongued, and unaccustomed to expressing affection openly, she holds a deep, quiet capacity for devotion and compassion. She strongly disapproves of tobacco, Daydreaming, and deceptive behavior. Over time, her reserved disposition softens into a mellow gentleness.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P51](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0051), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c8 P44](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0044), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)_

- Extremely neat and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Strict and moralistic  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping and dairy management  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v1 c14 P55](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0055)</sub>
- Sewing and garment making  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c14 P55](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0055)</sub>

## Goals

- To properly rear and educate Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089)</sub>
- To preserve and remain at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Residing at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother Obed, Thirza agreed to adopt a young boy from a Nova Scotian orphanage to help on their farm. When Obed accidentally brought home a young girl named Nell Harcourt due to a mix-up, Thirza initially insisted on returning her. However, out of compassion and Obed's quiet desire, Thirza decided to keep Nell and take charge of her upbringing. Over time, Thirza provided Nell with an education, spiritual guidance, and a home, gradually developing a deep, protective love for her despite occasional disciplinary struggles. Following Obed's death years later, Thirza faced financial hardship and failing vision, prompting her to consider selling Grey Shutters; however, Nell gave up her college scholarship to stay, teach, and keep the home together with Thirza.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)_

## Background by volume

- Reached adulthood before the current Grey Shutters house was constructed  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Overheard a painful comment about her appearance from an aunt as a small child  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch containing her mother's hair from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> No; you can just address me as Thirza. Being called Miss Abernethy is something I am unaccustomed to, and it would cause me to feel nervous.  <sub>[v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>

> No. I am not an aunt to you, and I disbelieve in using names for people that do not belong to them.  <sub>[v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)</sub>

> Until she confesses, she’ll stay in her room  <sub>[v1 c14 P24](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0024)</sub>
